topline.note: Session 179 shipped the missing /agents.json spine and a 23% ambient feature-bundle reduction. Session 180 therefore targets the next frontier, not a redesign: make the AI manifest discoverable without guessing, and keep subtracting route-only JavaScript from the universal cold path. Both items name an info-finding or conversion outcome and wait on no founder action.

founderEvidence: Current TASK_BOARD Now items are mostly evidence-gated verifies: TT re-probe, field-win confirmation, uptime-publish verification, geo-vitals watch, plus two SIL items: AI-DISCOVERY-SPINE-WAVE2 and AMBIENT-SPLIT-WAVE3 + DEAD-WIDGET-SWEEP. Code read showed /agents.json exists but _headers exposed only style/core preloads, so agents still had to know the manifest path or find robots.txt. Ambient read showed intent-flight-director.js only runs on six exact routes and ignis-answer-engine.js only mounts on [data-ask-ignis] or /search|/oracle, yet both still lived in the always-parsed feature bundle.

items.summary: The new /agents.json is correct, but discovery still depends on a crawler guessing the URL or reading robots.txt. Generated HTTP Link discovery makes the AI-agent manifest a first-class public surface.
items.why: Info-finding outcome: agentic crawlers can discover the studio manifest from the first response headers and then move to sitemap, llms.txt, shards, policy, and project entries without guesswork. The durable win is structural: the AI-spine gate now fails if the generated header disappears, so the manifest cannot quietly become dark matter again.
items.recipe: Add a generated _headers Link entry for /agents.json with rel=alternate and application/json type; add discovery.manifest to agents.json; extend check-ai-discovery-spine.mjs self-test and live validation to require the header. Rebuild agents.json, _headers, shell references, then run the AI-spine gates.

items.summary: Two remaining feature-bundle scripts are route-scoped but still parse on every public page: the pathfinder and static Ask IGNIS retrieval engine. They are useful conversion and info-finding surfaces, but only on the routes where they can mount.
items.why: Speed outcome: every cold visitor pays less JavaScript parse cost before interaction while the pathfinder and Ask IGNIS still load where they create user value. Conversion/info-finding outcome: the membership, games, universe, pulse, oracle, search, and explicit Ask IGNIS surfaces keep their intended guidance without making legal, brand, journal, or project pages parse irrelevant engines.
items.recipe: Move intent-flight-director.js and ignis-answer-engine.js out of AMBIENT_FEATURE_SOURCES. Add ambient-loader predicates that mirror each script's exact route/hook guard, rebuild ambient bundles and hashed shell assets, then run ambient coverage, placement, bundle drift, and shell coherency gates.
